caption:
GWM wants to be Australia's number five car brand, and it's driving through Parramatta to get there.

The Eels have signed GWM as official automotive partner on a multi-year deal from 2027, with its logo on the sleeve of both the NRL and NRLW jerseys. It lands two days after adidas signed on as the club's apparel partner. GWM already backs the Warriors and Richmond, so this one looks like a portfolio play.

Also today: Champion Data x A-Leagues, Carole Nash x British Superbike Championship, Tangerine x Bendigo Spirit, Crystalbrook Sam x Adelaide 36ers.
